title: AW28 Women's Trim Market Strategy
summary: Trim strategy for AW28 womenswear: durable, verifiable and easy to change late.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - Fashion entered 2027 expecting low single-digit growth, with markdown risk and faster growth in resale<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Build, test, sell through
sections.body:
| Action | Trims |
|---|---|
| Build | Horn, corozo and leather buttons; tonal piping |
| Test | Antique-gold hardware, embroidery |
| Sell through | Logo hardware |

design_implications: - Document trim materials for any environmental claim.
commercial_implications: - Late-added trims (embroidery, piping) let you react to sales.

sources.title: Fashion: 2027, the year growth will finally have to be profitable
